current.text: He is a rookie, drafted in the first round.
His Summer League was one of the worst ever for a pick that high. In one game he scored 3 points in 28 minutes on 13% shooting and missed every three.
He is not in the projected Chicago rotation. The starting five and the bench through the 10th man are listed without him.
In dynasty, Josh still values his college work and dropped him only a couple of spots, to rookie rank 18.

durable.text: He is a wing-sized forward with a high turnover rate.
He has upside as a shooter, passer and creator.

note: Yahoo ranks him 691 with a value of 0 USD. ESPN has no price for him, and the expert calls him not draftable, so he is far outside our 144-player auction pool.
